evidenceNotes: JPSC homepage lists recruitment of Assistant Professor in medical colleges (Super Specialist), advertisement 07/2026, linking exam_files.php?id=13045. Detail page links one press note and one original advertisement, both dated 15 April 2026.

Original Hindi advertisement page 1 and page 9 plus Hindi press note state 90 regular Assistant Professor vacancies, online applications 28 April to 12 May 2026 by 17:00. Later fee payment (14 May) and hard-copy receipt (25 May) are separate steps, not an application extension.

Pages 1-2 list ten super-specialty departments and DM/DNB/DrNB or MCh/DNB/DrNB specialty degrees; a basic biomedical research course is also named. Page 2 states minimum age 30 at 1 August 2025; category/sex/service upper limits on page 3 need founder verification.

Page 4 says Jharkhand permanent residence is needed for reservation benefits, not a blanket application condition. No explicit nationality or language proficiency rule was established in the checked notice; international applicant and interview language status need official confirmation.
Hindi PDF text uses legacy font encoding, so extracted text has mojibake. Original PDF pages were rendered and visually inspected; do not infer additional rules from the broken extraction.
